Add random noise to every pixel of training images.

Every pixel of a training image gets noise drawn from N(mean, sigma), on the device; with clip the result stays in [0, 1] (torchvision v2 GaussianNoise). Pixels are in [0, 1] here, before Normalize. Validation and test images pass through unchanged.

## Settings

| Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Mean | `mean` | Number | `0` |   | The run | Mean of the noise. |
| Sigma | `sigma` | Number | `0.1` | `>=0` | The run | Standard deviation of the noise, 0 or more. |
| Clip | `clip` | On / off | `true` |   | The run | Keep the result in [0, 1]. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | No: Gaussian Noise is a training image transform: the image batcher runs it on the ArrayFire device between Resize and Normalize; PipelineExecutor image transforms are not implemented |
| Training (the compiled model) | Yes, as a preprocessing step |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.

## Usage

```text
Resize -> Gaussian Noise -> Normalize -> Conv2D
```

```text
Noise from N(mean, sigma) on pixels in [0, 1], drawn on the device for every batch; clip keeps the result in [0, 1]. Validation and test pass through.
```

## Tips

- Helps models that must cope with noisy sensors or low light.
